status: registered before any chain output for these events was computed; qualitative cross-check of the unvalidated wirkungskette_v01 runout scenarios against documented damage fields; exploratory, no tuning
question: Does infrastructure inside the v01 runout scenarios started at inventory points agree qualitatively with the inventory damage fields Verkehrsanlagen and Bauwerke?
inspected_before_registration: inventory selection fields only (date, year, process, position quality, damage fields, distance to the demo centre); no route, scenario or infrastructure overlap was computed for these events before this file was written
not_claimed: hit rate, sensitivity or any validation of the runout
that the inventory point is the release point
that infrastructure inside a scenario was damaged
independence of the events (two Gasen campaigns in 2018, one event in 2017)

chain.rule: scenarios, energy-line parameters, corridor width and infrastructure types are taken unchanged from wirkungskette_v01; nothing is adjusted after seeing results

events.centre: demo centre of wirkungskette_v01 (Stanz im Mürztal)
events.damage_rule: both detail fields set (0 or 1); 1 = ja, 0 = nein; events with only SACHSCHADEN but empty detail fields are excluded and counted
events.dem_rule: event start (Date_Anfan, UTC) after the DEM object Last-Modified recorded in the v01 terrain checkpoint
events.primary_years_reason: task scope: Gasen campaigns 2017/2018, DEM before the event
events.secondary_set: all years satisfying dem_rule (adds July 2016 and 2023-2025); reported separately and labelled secondary
events.position_reason: a point uncertain by more than 100 m cannot be compared with a 50 m corridor; excluded and counted
events.process_reason: falls are not the process the runout scenarios describe

comparison.shortest_scenario: per event, the scenario with the smallest stop index along the route
comparison.longest_scenario: per event, the scenario with the largest stop index along the route

secondary_tables.label: Verkehrsanlagen gegen Straße, Forst-/Feldweg oder Bahn

comparison.hit_rule: infrastructure type counted as present if at least one feature of that type intersects the scenario corridor (count > 0 in scenario_chain output)
comparison.context: distance from the inventory point to the nearest road and nearest building (descriptive only), to show whether a corridor hit already arises at the start point
comparison.comparisons_counted: 2 primary tables x 2 scenarios + 1 secondary table x 2 scenarios, each on the primary and the secondary event set = 12 tables; all are reported

known_limits: point reference unknown: the inventory point may mark release, transport path, deposit or damage site
OpenStreetMap is today's state (2026), not the state at the event; objects may be newer or rebuilt
DEM object date 2016-04-26 is an upload date; the underlying survey is older
Verkehrsanlagen = 1 for almost all selected events, so the nein row is very small
